rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for saying that you are not feeling well.

example.english: I feel unwell today and want to take half a day off.
example.traditional: 我今日有啲唔舒服，想請半日假。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 jau5 di1 m4 syu1 fuk6 soeng2 cing2 bun3 jat6 gaa3

rows.note: Use this for a vague sense that your body feels off or something is not right.

example.english: I already felt unwell when I got up this morning.
example.traditional: 我朝早起身已經覺得唔妥。
example.jyutping: ngo5 ziu1 zou2 hei2 san1 ji5 ging1 gok3 dak1 m4 to5

rows.note: Use this when being unwell mainly shows as low energy or a washed-out appearance.

example.english: I feel unwell today and have no energy at all.
example.traditional: 我今日好唔精神，一啲力氣都冇。
example.jyutping: ngo5 gam1 jat6 hou2 m4 zing1 san4 jat1 di1 lik6 hei3 dou1 mou5
